result.reply:
That's a real bug if it's what it sounds like — a non-admin leaving deletes other people's drafts, not just their own. Before I can even describe the severity properly though: is this reproducible every time, or did you hit it once? And does "everyone else's drafts" mean all workspace members' drafts, or just drafts that were shared/visible to the person leaving?

Those matter because "any non-admin can silently wipe other people's unsaved work by leaving" is a much bigger deal than "an edge case tied to some specific draft state." Right now I can't tell which one we're looking at.

Either way — whether it blocks tomorrow isn't my call. What I can say: silent data loss triggered by a low-privilege action (leaving a workspace) is the kind of thing that's bad regardless of how rare the trigger is, since nobody gets a warning before it happens. Worth putting in front of whoever's making the ship call with the repro details, not just the summary.
